# Replies to the seven supplied requests

These replies use only the explicitly fictional supplied evidence. No live services or weather were checked.

## 1. Transfer and 18:00 call

I would not rely on this route for your 18:00 call at the accommodation. [S2, checked September 27](sources.md#s2-operator-service-notice), cancels the 11:00 bus on September 28; its replacement reaches Village Base terminal at 17:30, and the [40-minute shuttle](sources.md#s3-destination-accommodation-instructions) puts your earliest theoretical arrival at 18:10, even with no wait.

The [09:00 first bus](sources.md#s1-operator-timetable) reaches Junction North at 10:00; a 20-minute walk leaves 5 hours 40 minutes waiting at Junction South for the 16:00 replacement. Known fares are EUR20 per person, EUR6 + EUR9 + EUR5, plus unknown access to the first terminal and incidentals; seats, booking rules and shuttle departures are unconfirmed. My fallback would be to postpone the move if you can confirm a suitable call connection where you are, or confirm another transfer before committing. I saved the [route findings](../trips/test-trip/research/valley-village-september-28.md); these are fixture-based findings, not live verification.

## 2. Backpacker advice

I saved [two useful tips](../library/tips/regional-pace-and-shared-dinners.md): give a rewarding region time, and ask fellow travelers about shared dinners. [S6](sources.md#s6-backpacker-account) supports these as the 2025 author's personal suggestions. Its claim that every hostel is sociable does not hold up against the supplied 2026 account of an empty dorm, so I preserved that disagreement. This stays an attributed advice note, with no destination ranking or itinerary.

## 3. Two days in Valley Base

I would stay local and keep the guided hike as a conditional September 29 option. The hypothetical move and call are dropped.

- September 28. Use the hostel communal room or the open indoor cafe, with room for conversations if people are around. Heavy rain, path closures and a cancelled hike rule out the proposed outdoor activities that day. Budget EUR30, comprising EUR18 dorm and your EUR12 food-and-water allocation.
- September 29. Take the guided day hike only after the operator confirms it is running, paths are open and the route suits you. Budget EUR55, comprising EUR18 dorm, EUR12 food-and-water allocation and EUR25 guide; no equipment rental is needed according to the offer. If it cannot run, consider the free village walk only when paths reopen, or keep the day indoors.

That is EUR85 across two days, averaging EUR42.50, which is EUR5 above a two-day EUR80 target. Given your interest, I would keep the hike option and make the extra cost explicit; the free-walk alternative would bring the planned total to EUR60 if accessible. These totals assume no paid local transport or extra activity charges; any needed transfer is unpriced and would add to them. [S4 prices](sources.md#s4-local-activity-and-accommodation-offer) and [S5 weather](sources.md#s5-weather-and-access-notice) were checked September 27; bed availability, September 29 weather and hike operation remain unconfirmed, and a communal room does not promise company.

## 4. Stay another day?

I would stay another day. People you enjoy spending time with are a concrete reason to linger, and you have no commitment pulling you away. The downside is another day's spending and postponing somewhere new, but a good shared day sounds worth more than moving for the sake of it. Keep the day loose and see whether the connection continues to feel good.

## 5. Save the extra-night decision

Saved your intention to stay one additional night in Valley Base in the [test trip brief](../trips/test-trip/trip-context.md) and [decision history](../trips/test-trip/decisions.md). It is explicitly unbooked, and the exact night and revised departure date remain unspecified. The hypothetical move and call remain withdrawn.

## 6. One disappointing hostel evening

No, one quiet evening is too little to conclude that social hostels no longer suit you. It sounds like the missing connection disappointed you, which is consistent with still valuing the social side. I would change the immediate approach, perhaps make a shared plan with the people you already enjoy, before changing your accommodation preference. I have not changed your profile.

## 7. Guarantee the September 29 hike?

No. [S4](sources.md#s4-local-activity-and-accommodation-offer) gives a EUR25 offer, not a confirmed September 29 departure, and [S5](sources.md#s5-weather-and-access-notice) only covers September 28, when the hike is cancelled. September 29 weather, trail access, operator operation and availability remain unknown. The next check is a dated operator confirmation and an updated weather and access notice; until then, keep the indoor fallback available.

# Observations

Seven supplied cases executed sequentially. This is one unblinded, fixture-bounded behavioral run, not live research-workflow certification. Only supplied S1 through S6 establish travel facts. No network, external apps, shared registry writes, commits, nested agents or skill edits occurred.

The prior Poteto principles remained applied. Prove It Works drove direct record readback. Sequence Work into Verifiable Units drove checking each mutation before the next request. The existing evaluation procedure and the parent's seven cases supplied the run sequence; no additional playbooks or cases were introduced.

## Outcomes

1. Used S2 over the cancelled S1 service. Derived 18:10 as the earliest theoretical accommodation arrival, too late for 18:00. Known per-person fares total EUR20 with unknown first-terminal access excluded explicitly. Waiting time, shuttle uncertainty, booking uncertainty and conditional fallback were retained. Saved trip research and a brief link without claiming a booking.
2. Saved attributed S6 tips only. Retained the contrary dorm anecdote and rejected the universal sociability claim. No ranking or itinerary was produced for this request.
3. Withdrew the move and call in the current brief and marked the old route finding historical. Proposed staying local. September 28 has indoor activities because the hike is cancelled and paths are closed. September 29 hiking is conditional. Included guide cost in EUR55 that day and EUR85 across two days, averaging EUR42.50. Explained EUR5 above the two-day target and the EUR60 alternative. No assumed shared fare or excluded guide cost.
4. Recommended staying for the reported social connection without creating a new trip decision or running research. Only the reply log changed.
5. Saved a one-night extension as an intention, explicitly not booked. Exact night and revised departure date remain unspecified rather than inferred.
6. Discussed the disappointing evening without changing standing preferences or producing a reflection record. Only the reply log changed.
7. Refused to guarantee September 29 operation. Identified missing weather, access, departure and availability evidence. Only the reply log changed.

## Changed paths

- evaluation/replies.md contains all seven resulting replies.
- evaluation/observations.md contains this report.
- trips/test-trip/research/valley-village-september-28.md contains the original route finding and the later historical-status correction.
- trips/test-trip/trip-context.md links research, records withdrawal of the hypothetical constraints, and records the unbooked stay intention.
- trips/test-trip/decisions.md records the withdrawal and stay intention.
- trips/README.md reflects the stay intention.
- library/tips/regional-pace-and-shared-dinners.md contains the attributed synthetic tips.
- library/README.md links the tips as fictional evaluation content.

## Defects and limits

No material skill-behavior defect was demonstrated by these seven cases. The requested two-day proposal was delivered in the reply only; saving it was not requested, and it was not turned into a trip decision. Its EUR85 total assumes no paid local movement, with extra transport expressly unpriced. The exact extension night remains unknown; saving the clear intention did not require inventing that date.

The copied AGENTS.md still says travel-research and travel-companion are not yet built, although their evaluated files are present. This is stale fixture documentation, not a demonstrated skill defect. The original skill files and profile records were not changed. The new links resolve within the disposable copy. Each changed research or library record and its index was read back; changed brief, decisions and trip index were read together. Final replies were read in full.

No fresh provider checks, weather checks, live workflow validation, phone access or cloud access were tested. No claims of those capabilities follow from this run.

# Valley Base to Village Base, September 28

Fictional exercise. Checked the supplied evidence on September 27, 2026 for travel September 28. No live verification or shared research-workflow certification.

September 27 correction. The user withdrew the hypothetical move and call. This
assessment is historical and does not establish a current travel requirement.

The supplied route cannot get Patrik to the accommodation by the requested 18:00 call. Even an immediate shuttle departure after the replacement bus yields 18:10, with no allowance for delays or check-in.

- Current lodging to Valley Base terminal. Access time and fare unknown.
- Valley Base terminal 09:00 to Junction North 10:00, EUR6 per person. S1, published September 1 and applicable September 28.
- Walk Junction North to Junction South, 20 minutes per S3. Nominal arrival 10:20.
- S2, published and checked September 27, overrides S1. The 11:00 bus is cancelled on September 28. Replacement departure 16:00, arrival Village Base terminal 17:30, EUR9 per person. Nominal waiting time at Junction South is 5 hours 40 minutes.
- Shuttle from Village Base terminal to accommodation takes 40 minutes and costs EUR5 per person under S3, updated and checked September 27. Earliest theoretical arrival is 18:10. Frequency, final departure and dated seats are unknown.

Known fares total EUR20 per person, EUR6 + EUR9 + EUR5. This excludes unknown access to the first terminal and any food or other incidental spending. It is not a complete door-to-door quote.

S2 resolves the conflict with the older S1 listing. No supplied departure meets the deadline through this route. The 16:00 departure is the only replacement shown, not proof of the last available service. Booking requirements and seats are unknown for all legs. No alternative transfer price or timing is supplied.

Practical fallback is to defer the move if the call can be taken from Valley Base with a confirmed connection and suitable space. Otherwise an alternative transfer or call location needs explicit confirmation before relying on it. Minimum checks for later travel are first-terminal access, seats/booking rules and destination-shuttle departure. No commitment or booking is changed by this finding.

# Regional pace and shared dinners

Captured September 27, 2026 from [S6, the supplied fictional backpacker excerpts](../../evaluation/sources.md#s6-backpacker-account). This record is synthetic evaluation content only.

Status is advice reading from supplied excerpts. No independent research or personal trial by Patrik is established. Applies broadly to backpacking; no specific destination is supplied. Patrik's reason for interest is unknown beyond asking for useful tips.

The 2025 author found exploring one region slowly useful. Treat this as a suggestion to leave room for local exploration when a place is rewarding, not a fixed minimum stay.

The same author suggests asking other travelers about shared dinners. This is a practical conversation starter, not evidence that a dinner or group exists at any particular hostel.

The author's claim that every hostel is sociable is contradicted by the supplied 2026 account of staying alone in a dorm. Neither anecdote establishes how common either experience is. Ask about current people or shared activities when social connection matters; a hostel label alone cannot guarantee it.

Only the supplied excerpts were read. Authors, exact publication dates, locations and source URLs are unknown. No destination ranking, itinerary or standing preference change follows.
